mobileAccess.title: Mobile and remote access
mobileAccess.subtitle: Pair your devices and control what each can access
mobileAccess.invalidCode: Pairing code is invalid, used or expired
mobileAccess.approved: Device approved; connect on your phone
mobileAccess.approveFailed: Approval failed. Check the code and permissions
mobileAccess.revokeHint: New requests will be rejected immediately and open connections will close within seconds. Chat history is retained.
mobileAccess.howTo: Enter this server's HTTPS address on your phone. Enter its pairing code here, inspect the device and approve it.
mobileAccess.httpsRequired: Remote mobile access requires a reachable HTTPS address. Configure the existing TLS or a trusted reverse proxy first.
mobileAccess.addressHint: The QR code contains only the server address. The pairing secret stays on the phone, outside URLs. Each device can be revoked separately.
mobileAccess.pairingCode: Pairing code shown on the phone
mobileAccess.notificationHint: Foreground status uses the existing notification connection. Background notifications and Live Activity pushes require your APNS / FCM project, app signing and OS notification permission.
mobileAccess.confirmDeviceHint: Check this device name against your phone before choosing capabilities.
mobileAccess.capabilityHint: Devices never inherit administrator status. Model, connector and global settings management stay disabled. Browser, desktop, terminal and remote phone control require explicit grants.
mobileAccess.pushHint: Use your own Apple APNS or Firebase project. Keys are encrypted; configuration does not send a test notification.
mobileAccess.pushConfigFailed: Could not save push configuration. Check the project, key and topic.
mobileAccess.privateKey: Signing private key (not returned after saving)
mobileAccess.remoteSetupHint: Use existing HTTPS, your reverse proxy or a private Tailscale network. Saving an address does not open ports. The check verifies DNS, certificates, routing and this host identity.
mobileAccess.remoteActionFailed: Operation did not complete. Check the address, Tailscale login and existing mappings. Other services are preserved.
mobileAccess.deploymentGuide: Local / Docker / reverse proxy deployment guide
mobileAccess.tailscaleHint: Use an installed, signed-in Tailscale client to create private HTTPS access to this Octop. Your phone must join the same network. Funnel is never enabled and other services are preserved.
mobileAccess.tailscaleSignedIn: Signed in locally. Check your private network access rules before enabling.
mobileAccess.tailscaleSignIn: Sign in using the local Tailscale app and enable HTTPS in your network settings first.

checkReason.ready: This address reaches this Octop with a trusted certificate and matching identity.
checkReason.identity_mismatch: A different host answered. Check the domain and proxy target before approving devices.
checkReason.dns: The domain could not be resolved.
checkReason.connection_or_certificate: Connection or certificate check failed. Check networking, ports and a trusted certificate.
checkReason.route_or_proxy: HTTPS connected but the mobile identity route is unavailable. Check the reverse proxy and program version.
